# .github/empty-test-rows.txt — THE EMPTY-ROW LEDGER: every CI row that may
# record go test runs in which no test passed.
#
#   empty <row> <reason>
#
# A row whose go test ran and passed nothing (every test skipped, or no test
# matched) exits 0 and checked nothing. tools/gotestreport refuses it by name
# (NO TEST PASSED) unless the row is declared here and the step names it:
#
#   go run ./tools/gotestreport ... -row <row> -empty-rows .github/empty-test-rows.txt <dir>
#
# A declared row that passes a test is red too (STALE EMPTY): delete its line.
# Adding a line here never makes a test run; it says, in the open, which row
# checks nothing by go test and why. Today no row does.
